title: Simultaneous movement of two registers
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration with $m$ Boolean work tapes, state set $\Lambda$, and fixed input $x$. For states $s,s'\in\Lambda$, register indices $r_1,r_2\in\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$, integer $k$, and movement $mv\in\{-1,0,1\}$, applying the action that moves both designated register heads by $mv$ and enters state $s'$ to the configuration obtained from $c$ by setting the state to $s$ and both designated head positions to $k$ yields the configuration with state $s'$, unchanged input position, tapes, and output, and both designated head positions set to $k+mv$.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration $c$ for $m$ Boolean work tapes, state set $\Lambda$, and input $x$
